item.description: ADR-0001 Use MathStruct Quartz ADR-0002 Reuse mathlib ADR-0003 Keep Julia and Lean in one repository ADR-0004 Nimbers as the default representation of GF(2^n) Add a dated or numbered ADR when a choice affects architecture, interfaces, dependencies, or mathematical conventions.

item.title: ADR-0001 Use MathStruct Quartz
item.description: ADR-0001: Use MathStruct Quartz Status: accepted Context The project needs a browsable Obsidian vault with mathematical documentation and TikZ diagrams.

item.title: ADR-0002 Reuse mathlib
item.description: ADR-0002: Reuse mathlib Status: accepted Context Lean is intended to state and prove the project’s mathematics, but finite-field constructions and theorems may already exist in mathlib.

item.title: ADR-0003 Keep Julia and Lean in one repository
item.description: ADR-0003: Keep Julia and Lean in one repository Status: accepted Context Julia is the executable library and Lean is its formal specification/proof environment.

item.title: ADR-0004 Nimbers as the default representation of GF(2^n)
Lean and mathlib
item.description: Lean files live under lean/; lean/lean-toolchain and the mathlib release in lakefile.lean are intentionally aligned.
